text:
sam (PM): quick sync threadBankingPilot asked for a product thats between Hosted and Dedicated: route-level quota lanes, purchasable priority-minutes, and a pilot SLA credit mechanic. can we scope what we can ship fast?
mei (Sales): customer will commit monthly spend but not take Dedicated. must have: predictable throughput for two hotspots (route_x, route_y) and a clear remediation if latency degrades.
alex (Pricing): product levers I see: route quota lanes (soft guarantees), priority-minute tokens (consumed when a route is promoted), and time-boxed surge windows. commercial = commit + premium for priority consumption. need unit-econ inputs.
diego (Eng): doable with runtime changes: token-bucket per-route, priority queue path, and optional KV prefix pinning. hard isolation (GPU reservation) -> Dedicated. infra notes: memory for pinned prefixes and eviction policy required.
tara (Legal): if SLA credits are included, we need: measurement window, credit cap, exclusions (maintenance, force majeure), and a data residency addendum (customer requires EU).
sam (PM): proposed pilot "route-quota-lanes beta" (4 weeks): - per-route soft QPS buckets (configurable) - priority-minute tokens billed separately - automatic downgrade to baseline model when quota exhausted - SLA credit formula: minutes where p99 > target * credit unit. please +1/-1 and call out missing pieces.
mei (Sales): +1 from sales. customer accepts non-binding pilot SLA if SLOs are explicit and measurable. they asked route gating by id only.
alex (Pricing): +1. acceptance criteria: baseline token economics, estimated priority-minute consumption, uplift % and a spend cap per-customer to prevent runaway bills. will propose pricing bands after eng cost delta.
diego (Eng): eng acceptance: 1) runtime supports per-route token buckets and priority flag 2) KV-pinning MVP (pin by prefix) with mem limits 3) feature-flag rollout + canary. estimate: spike 10 working days, pilot build 2-3 sprints.
ops-bot: reminder created "route-quota pilot kickoff" 2026-05-18 14:00 UTC
tara (Legal): I'll draft a pilot addendum with credit cap = min(monthly commit, 20%), plus EU residency clause.
sam (PM): acceptance checklist (pilot): - API + console toggle to mark route priority - runtime: token buckets, priority path, KV pinning - billing: meter for priority-minutes + per-route reporting - pricing: bands + spend cap - legal: pilot addendum + EU addendum - sales: signed pilot acceptance from customer - observability: dashboard with p50/p95/p99 by route and priority consumption
mei (Sales): I'll get the signed pilot acceptance today. any constraints from eng on route id format?
diego (Eng): route id must be alphanumeric + dash; we'll document. over-limit returns 429/403 depending on auth.
alex (Pricing): decision criteria to GA suggestion: pilot net MRR uplift >= 10% and p99 impact on baseline routes <= 18%.
tara (Legal): GA expansion requires liability review. pilot T&C will be limited.
sam (PM): actions: - diego: spike & short design doc (10d) - alex: unit-econ scenarios (5d) - tara: pilot addendum draft (3d) - mei: signed acceptance (1d) - sam: pilot dashboard mock + checklist (3d) reconvene after spike. :thumbsup:
